spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (शणति)
1 To give.
2 To move.

n. (-णं)
1 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.)
2 Bengal Saṇ, a plant from which a kind of hemp is prepared, (Crotolaria juncea and other kinds.)
3 An arrow.
E.
शण to give, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Made of or from Bengal flax or Śaṇa.
mf. (-णः-णी)
1 A touchstone.
2 A whet or grindstone.
3 A weight of four Māṣas.
4 A saw.
n. (-णं)
Coarse cloth, sack cloth, canvas.
f. (-णी)
1 Ragged or torn raiment.
2 A new unseamed and single breadth of cloth, given to the religious student at his investiture for his upper garment.
3 A ragged garment given to the Jaina ascetic at his initiation.
4 A small tent or screen, used especially as a retiring room for actors, and tumblers, &c.
5 Gesture, gesticulation, making signs with the hands or eyes, &c.
E.
शण to give, aff. घञ्; or शो to sharpen, and ण aff.; or शण Saṇ, and अण् aff. of derivation.

(उ) षणु r. 8th cl. (सनोति सनुते)
1 To give.
2 To serve or honor; also written षन.

f. (-न्तुः)
The thread or string made of the flax of the Crotolaria juncea.
E.
शण, and तन्तु string.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Made of Saṇ string.
E.
शणतन्तु, and अण् aff.

f. (-र्णी)
A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.)
E.
शण Saṇ, and पर्ण a leaf, having similar leaves.

f. (-का)
Crotolaria of several species.
E.
शण the Saṇ, पुष्प a flower, aff. ङीष्, and कन् added, fem. form, implying resemblance; also शणपुष्पी, &c.

n. (-त्रं)
1 The fibre or flax of the Saṇ plant, or string made from it.
2 A net made of hemp or of Saṇ, or the thread of the Crotolaria juncea.
3 Cordage, twine.
E.
शण hemp, &c. सूत्र a thread.

n. (-त्रं)
Packthread.
E.
see शणसूत्र, the sibilants being interchanged.

m. (-लुः)
A plant, (Cassia fistula.)

n. (-रं)
1 A rock or small island in the midst of the river Śoṇa.
2 An insular spot inclosed by the branches of the Serjū, where it falls into the Ganges above Cūprah, at Bhṛgurāśrama or Bageressan; called also, the bank of the Dardarī.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A bull at liberty.
2 A eunuch.
n. (-ण्डं)
A multitude of lotus flowers.
E.
शण or षण to give, aff. ड, hence also षण्ड, and differently derived, शण्ठ or षण्ट the more usual form.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A bull at liberty.
2 A eunuch.
3 A multitude, a heap.
mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
A quantity of lotuses.
E.
षण to give, ड Uṇādi aff.; also शण्ड, षण्ढ, and शण्ड, &c.

m. (-ण्डः)
A eunuch: see षण्ड, and शण्ड, &c. the sibilants being interchanged.

f. (-ता)
1 The state of a bull let loose or at liberty.
2 Emasculation.
E.
शण्ड a bull at liberty, &c. तल् aff.

m. (-लः)
The name of a Muni, and ancestor of a particular family of Brahmans.
E.
शण्ड a eunuch, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ण्ढः)
1 A eunuch.
2 A eunuch or emasculated attendant, as employed in a Haram or seraglio.
3 An impotent man.
4 A bull at liberty.
5 A mad man or a drunken man.
E.
शम to bear or endure, Uṇādi aff. ढ; also षण्ढ and शण्ड, &c.

m. (-ण्ढः)
A eunuch: see षण्ड.

m. (-वः)
An armourer.
E.
शाण a whetstone, आजीव who lives by.

m. (-णिः)
A plant from the fibres of which a coarse cloth is prepared, (Corchorus olitorius.)
E.
शण Bengal Śaṇ, and ईञ् aff. implying descent or resemblance.

m. (-ल्यः)
1 A tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
2 A Muni from whom one of the three principal families of the Kanouj or Kanyākubja Brahmans is said to be descended.
3 A form of AGNI or fire.
E.
शण्डिल a saint, यञ् aff. of descent, &c.

f. (-ली)
1 A measure of oil, the vessel holding a

Chitank.
2

A wanton woman.
3 A pond, a pool.
E.
षण्ड a bull, a eunuch, &c., and अल to be able, affs. अच् and ङीप्.

m. (-सः)
A half year, six months.
E.
षष्, and मास a month.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Six months old, of six months standing, &c.
E.
षण्मास, and यत् aff.; also षाण्मास्य.

m. (-खः)
KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
षष् six, and मुख face.

m. (-रः)
KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
षष् six, and मातृ a mother, अण् aff.; having been brought up by the six Kṛttikās.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of or relating to six months, half yearly, &c.
E.
षण्मास, and ठञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Perching, alighting, (as a bird.)
E.
सम् before डी to fly, aff. क्त, form irr.
